path.name: PC_R0_Replay192_q2_s0_NativeStrong
path.scope: Exact additive mean client-TTFT boundaries. Prepare is a host input-preparation boundary. It is not GPU kernel start. Service enclosures include host work,transfer and synchronization. The sum does not decompose TTFT p95. Decode residency is not pure decode GPU time. Under C3,P submit-to-ready includes worker queueing and other requests between chunks. It is not an exclusive per-request service cost.
